executive_summary: Northwind Studio proposes a 14-week engagement to design and build Beacon's patient-facing mobile experience. Our team will deliver a research-driven information architecture, a polished iOS/Android design system, and production-ready React Native components. This proposal covers Discovery, Design, and Engineering phases with a clear handoff plan at each milestone.

sections.title: The Opportunity
sections.content: Beacon's current patient portal has a 28% task completion rate and a 4.1-star App Store rating — well below the 4.6 category benchmark. User interviews surfaced three root causes: confusing appointment flow, unclear medication reminders, and a visual design that erodes trust in a clinical context. A ground-up redesign addresses all three while establishing a scalable design system for future product lines.

sections.title: Our Approach
sections.content: We work in three tightly-coupled phases. Phase 1 (Discovery, weeks 1–3): generative research with 20 patients and 8 clinicians, competitive audit, and a Jobs-to-be-Done framework that prioritizes 12 key user scenarios. Phase 2 (Design, weeks 4–9): IA + user flows, hi-fi Figma prototypes, and 3 rounds of usability testing. Phase 3 (Engineering, weeks 10–14): React Native build, Storybook component library, and integration testing with your existing EHR API.

sections.title: Team & Timeline
sections.content: The engagement runs 14 weeks from contract signing. Core team: 1 Design Lead, 1 UX Researcher, 2 Product Designers, 1 Engineering Lead, 2 Frontend Engineers. Weekly syncs every Tuesday at 10am PT. Milestone reviews at weeks 3, 6, 9, and 14. All design artifacts delivered via Figma; engineering deliverables via your GitHub organization.
